lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Monsieur Cooler! It seems that your brother Freeza is destroying ze planet Vegeta!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Very impressive, killing off a bunch of monkeys.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Any liquored-up hillbilly with a shotgun could've done that at the zoo.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Wait, sir! It seems he has missed one ship!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: We are within range to intercep--

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Because if he's going to whine to our father for control over the entire system like a spoiled little brat... ...then he's going to accept the responsibility.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: If this comes back to bite him... ...that's his fault.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Your brother, Lord Freeza... he has been... ...le killed.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Oh, is that right? And who, Sauza, killed him?

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Well, I sure hope somebody picks up that phone.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I can't believe your mom's letting you go camping with us after that whole Namek thing.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, I had to make the excuse that I'm studying fauna.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I have to chart down 12 different species of fern.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Wow, that smells fantastic! What's in there?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh, you know, just some essentials.

lines.speaker: Fish
lines.text: Halt, stalwart stranger! If you let me go, I shall grant you one wish.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I wish for you to be my dinner!

lines.speaker: Fish
lines.text: Help! Help! Help! Helllp! Helllp! Helllp!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Whoa-ho! Sounds like Goku caught a big one this time!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: As a space Frenchman, I must say, I find zis food completely detestable!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Rot in hell, Krillin! I almost ate that!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You get away from my food, my friend, my two emergency foods, and my son!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Well, well! I believe zat is ze monkey we are looking for!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait, what did he just say?

lines.speaker: Doore
lines.text: Oi! 'E said you're the monkey we're looking for!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright, just tell me who you are.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am having the worst case of deja mustard right now.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Monsieur Cooler! We have zis under control!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: It took us three months to get here. I am not staying in the ship.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Ha! You think zis is Freeza?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Cooler than Freezer? You must be ice cold!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: No, that would be my father.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Well, too bad; I sign your paychecks. Search the forest.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Do you have Icarus? 'Cause I'm staaarvin'.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We're hidden in a cave. No one can find us, so we should be safe.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: And now, ze perfect place for a shopping mall!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: It will have a cigarette shop, a baguette restaurant, ze Napoleon Museum, and a movie theater only showing films starring Jean Reno!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Ah, I see a bunch of idle hands just standing around!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Well, Monsieur Cooler, he has most likely been vaporized; much like a good portion of ze forest.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Because until I see a *body*, I believe my brother did a better job at killing him than you.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: By the end of this, I'll have *someone's* corpse tied to the bumper of my ship.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Icarus, if this is another dead rabbit, I swear to God I'm gonna kill you.

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: He's saying they're trapped under the rocks.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, Goku! Are you in there?!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin! We're trapped under the rocks! We're running out of air! Help us!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait, why do you need my help; can't Goku bench press a planet?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Take Icarus to Korin's Tower so you don't alert their Scouters.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Pick up some Senzu Beans for Goku and hurry back.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Because last time I hung out with him, I totally forgot what his name was and just kept calling him "Whiskers the Wonder Cat" the whole time.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Krillin? What smells like dragon's breath?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Shame, Goku... Lots and lots of shame...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Come on, Icarus, not much longer.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I wonder how Yajirobe and Korin are doing.

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: I told you to use the brush before you got in the shower!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Your hair clogs up the drain!

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: And I told you to stay out of my kitty treats!

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: Seriously, they're for CATS! Why do you eat them?!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: I swear, the only reason I live here is because it's rent-free!

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: The only reason I *let* you live here is because you give the best belly rubs for a hundred miles!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: Don't say that in front of the kid!

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: What? You should be proud, you know how to rub this pussy real good.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Can... I have my Senzu Beans?

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: Hey! Those are *my* Senzu Beans! You can't just--

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: That's it, I'm done! Grab your stuff and get off my tower!

lines.speaker: Korin
lines.text: D'ah-- agh, you scared him off!

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: You were the one screaming your head off.

lines.speaker: Yajirobe
lines.text: I told you - I'm not ready for kids!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Pour that maple syrup... All over my breakfast... You beautiful lady who lives in my house...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You know, Icarus, I know you like flying fast, but maybe we should be more careful now just to--

lines.speaker: Doore
lines.text: 'Ey boys! Remember when I said I once popped a man's skull with me bare 'ands?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Okay, I think I got this one:

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Pretty one; stupid one; one with weird powers.

lines.speaker: Doore
lines.text: But I'd say I'm more handsome than pretty.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: And my powers are not zat weird!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Okay, I take it back; you're all stupid.

lines.speaker: Doore
lines.text: Someone check the clock, because I believe it's go time!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Gohan! You know what to do!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: You babbling fool! He was aiming for Doore!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Zat is right, I forgot you can do zat! <Trés bien>.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: I'm going to go get zat child. You finish him off and bring ze body back to Cooler.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: You know how he likes zat!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Ha! <Bon, mon ami>, but not *bon* enough!

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Hey, know what this reminds me of?'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'That scene from Return of the Jedi!'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Oh, I didn't know we could do that!'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Yeah, I forget about them sometimes, too.'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'Oh man - speaking of Star Wars, check that out! Lightsaber!'

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: 'Lightsabers don't stick out of people's arms!'

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: 'It's *totally* making the same sound; you can't make that up!'

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: If you strike me down, I'll only become stro--

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: You may have killed our men, but he won't let you get away with zis!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: That's "He" with a capital H, by the way.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ♫ Dragon meat is yummy... ♫ ♫ And I really want it in my tummy... ♫

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But I have these Senzu Beans!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Aw, but those are bland and tasteless!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You know, in my experience, cooking actually makes them worse.

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: I saw you risking your life for those and I thought, "Wow, those must be important!"

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Please tell me zey were important.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Those were our only hope, you *bastard*!
Sauza pummels Krillin in the background

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I probably should've mentioned I still have this one.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Why does this one smell weird?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Don't worry, Dad! You take Cooler; I'll take the small fry--

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: And now to lay ze coup de grâce to ze King of Kongs!
Scouter beeps for an extended period of time

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: But ze only one in zere was the dying monkey and ze pig!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: Could it be... ...ze legendary Super Swine?!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: So, I really don't think I appreciate you beating on my friends and family.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: So, wait - which one does this constitute? Friend or family?

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I'm going to guess friend, considering...

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Oh, I wouldn't go anywhere near him if I were you...

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: He seems to have come down with a terrible case of explosions...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Seriously, I don't want to catch that.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Unfortunately, after I kill you... ...I'm going to give the whole planet a terrible case of explosions.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: So, basically I'm going to blow up the planet.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I see how you handled my little shit brother so easily!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: And that is the history of my family.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wow, I'm... sorry about your dad...

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Oh, don't even get me started again...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, I assure you - if I ever have a son, I'll treat him better!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Pissing and moaning if he didn't own every galaxy.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: And didn't he just rabble on... "Dirty monkey, this! Dirty monkey, that!"

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh, that is just him! That is exactly him! To a P!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: See, though... ...that's the difference between him and I.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Tonight I dine on monkey soup!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Why do I let people do that--?!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I'ma plant me a dumbass tree!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Oh, this is gonna be great...!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Look at you... ...wasted and gasping for air.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: But you don't get to go yet.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: When your planet is in ashes... ...then, you have my permission to die.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You were taken before your time!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Go, Toriyama... ...and teach a dinosaur to ride a ball!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I see! This must be the power you used to kill my brother.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Not going anywhere for a while?

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I... can't help but feel we're both missing some context, here...

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Technically, I can't be on a planet... ...*if there is no planet*!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: By the way, before I throw this thing... ...did my brother do this?
Strained grunting continues in the background

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: My brother would've stood around postulating and claiming his victory... ...like some haughty, green-horned child.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I know what it takes to get the job done.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Which is why Father should have--!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I'll just make another one and--

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I know there's some kind of hubristic irony to consider here, but I'm far too distracted by the coldness of space!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Wait... no, now it's actually getting sorta toasty...

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Oh shit, now it's REALLY getting toasty!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: I really am just like my brother...!

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: Because if he's going to whine to our father for control over the entire system like a spoiled little brat... ...then he's going to accept the responsibility.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: If this comes back to bite him... ...that's his fault.

lines.speaker: Cooler
lines.text: 'But at least I know... I'm... still... Cooler...'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sun... ...you grow my food... ...you kill my enemies.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You're totally worth the skin cancer.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yup! And we all pitched in!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: You may have defeated Monsieur Cooler... ...but now you face ze wrath of Sauza!

lines.speaker: Sauza
lines.text: 'I will see you in Space Hell... cousin Jeice.'
